title: fix(app-shell): the draft preview bar promises sample data only while a seed draft is pending (objectui#13140)
body:
Fixes #13140
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The draft preview bar's hint "Sample data appears once you publish" now shows only while a `seed` draft is pending. Before, it showed whenever any change was pending, so a package with no sample data, whose records were already on screen, was promised example records on publish.

`packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx`:

- `seedPending` is `pendingEntries.some((entry) => entry.type === 'seed')`, read from the `_drafts` entries the bar already holds (`usePendingDrafts`).
- The Publish band still renders whenever changes are pending. The sparkles icon and the two copy lines render only when `seedPending` is true. Without them the band holds the Publish button alone, and `ml-auto` keeps it on the right.
- `data-testid="draft-preview-sample-hint"` moved from the band to the hint's own wrapper (the icon and the two lines), so the selector `[data-testid="draft-preview-sample-hint"]` now means "the sample-data promise is on screen". The band has no test id. Publish keeps `draft-preview-publish`.

The copy keys `preview.draftBar.sampleDataTitle` / `sampleDataBody` are unchanged, so no locale pack moves. No export, prop, type member, schema key or locale key moves. No new endpoint: the signal comes from the read the bar already makes.

## Why this signal (the PM's mechanism assumptions, measured)

1. **The hint's only condition was a pending change.** Confirmed on `origin/main` `2af42d9` (`7d497de` plus one unrelated commit): the band rendered under `!noChanges` and nothing else.
2. **Whether Publish will load sample data is knowable from data already read.** Yes. Publishing loads rows only for a `seed` draft it promotes. In objectstack (read at `5fcc79497`):
   - `PublishMetaItemResponseSchema.seedApplied` is documented as "Present ONLY when the published type is `seed` — publishing a seed is what makes its rows live".
   - `publishPackageDrafts` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` collects `seedBodies` only from published drafts whose `type === 'seed'`, and applies them only when there are some (`seedBodies.length > 0 ? await this.applySeedBodies(seedBodies) : undefined`).
   - The registry row for type `seed` in `kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` reads "Fixture / initialization data applied on publish".
   
   On this side, the bar's Publish (`usePublishAllDrafts`) publishes `listDrafts({})`. That is the same env-wide `_drafts` list the bar's `usePendingDrafts({ enabled })` reads, and that hook already tells seeds apart by the raw stored type `'seed'` (it orders package-less seeds last). So "a pending `seed` entry" is exactly "this Publish will load sample rows". It is not a guess from a name, and it needs no new read.
3. **Copy-only fallback.** Not taken. A true signal exists, so the sentence keeps its meaning and shows only where it holds.

Scope is env-wide on purpose, matching what the button publishes. A seed pending in another package still loads rows when this Publish runs. Narrowing the hint to the previewed app's package would need an app-to-package mapping the bar does not read today.

## Behaviour change to an existing pin

`DraftPreviewBar.test.tsx` used to pin that an **unknown** count (the `_drafts` read failed) keeps both Publish and the sample-data hint. Publish stays visible, because the fail-safe for the action is unchanged. The hint no longer shows, because a failed read lists no entries, so nothing backs the promise. The test is renamed and now asserts this.

## Tests

`packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftPreviewBar.test.tsx`:

- a pending `object` and `seed`: the hint shows "Sample data appears once you publish", and Publish reads "Publish to see it live" (the old positive test, now with a seed);
- new, a pending change with no seed (a `view` draft `account.kanban`): Publish is offered, there is no `draft-preview-sample-hint` element, and the bar's text has no "sample data" or "example records";
- an unknown count: Publish is visible and there is no hint;
- unchanged: a known zero count drops Publish, Changes and the hint.

Runs at head `81d7e9e`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/preview/ packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.pendingDraftsPulse-13139.test.tsx` (every preview test, plus the objectui#13139 suite that mounts the real bar): `Test Files 30 passed (30)`, `Tests 216 passed (216)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) after `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` (28/28 tasks): exit 0. Counted with `--listFilesOnly`, the test file is in the second program and the component is in the first.

### Ablation (one-off, not kept)

The fix was committed (`81d7e9e`) first. `ablation-replace.mjs` was then run on `DraftPreviewBar.tsx`, with the anchor `const seedPending = pendingEntries.some((entry) => entry.type === 'seed');` (one hit each time), and `DraftPreviewBar.test.tsx` was run under each mutation. The test imports the component by relative path, so no `dist/` is involved.

- Replaced with `const seedPending = true;` (the old behaviour): blob `80a7a2b1d97f` became `e256408d2484`, and `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`. The two failures are the no-seed test and the unknown-count test.
- Replaced with `const seedPending = false;` (the hint never shows): blob `80a7a2b1d97f` became `54acd4f6ee49`, and `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`. The failure is the seed-pending test.
- Both restores were proven by the tool: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`80a7a2b1d97f`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Local gates (head `81d7e9e`, exit captured before any pipe)

- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. It reports 2 source files of 1 released package changed and 1 changeset declared.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: exit 0, with `VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0 each.
- `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `pnpm check:test-path-roots` (the touched test file): exit 0 each.
- Not run, because no i18n key or docs fence moved: the i18n key, drift and dead-key gates, and the doc fence gates. Repo-wide lint and the full test farm run in CI.

## Acceptance notes

- No browser reading was taken, and none was owed by this dispatch. The selector to read is `[data-testid="draft-preview-sample-hint"]`. On the card's repro (a published package with no seed, real records, one pending view) it should be absent while `draft-preview-publish` is present. On an AI-built app with a pending seed it should be present.
- The band comment in `DraftPreviewBar.tsx` now describes the seed condition. No README or `content/docs` page mentions this hint (searched for "Sample data appears", "magic moment" and "Publish to see it live"), so no docs change.
